trigger: First run frozen native full/records-blocked same-question single-fact controls. Train matched query-capacity controls if needed to establish carrier readout, then return to value-paired multi-fact semantic updates. Single-fact success is not the research objective.
question: Is the negative result constrained by missing direct GDN query adaptation rather than only too few optimization steps?
research_scope: A matched-capacity diagnostic for the whole hybrid semantic write/read project, not a replacement architecture contribution.
targets: GDN in_proj_qkv query channels before short convolution only
requirements: Implement a separate opt-in controller; preserve the historical runtime and GroupController source so archived results remain replayable.
Verify actual projection shapes and parameter counts. Keep GDN K/V slices and all native projection outputs exact except the selected query residual; do not alter native attention output gates.
Preserve all pre-question KV, recurrent and convolution computation exactly at initialization and after nonzero updates, including sampled trained short/long prefixes.
Match the registered paired 128 examples, cyclic order, optimizer settings and fixed 64/256/1024 update budgets; use training and original validation only and no benchmark-based checkpoint selection.
Check finite nonzero query-adapter gradients and frozen-backbone gradients; observe actual zero record probabilities in teacher forcing and cached answers.
Save adapter/optimizer/RNG snapshots and hashes; compare every fixed checkpoint to the ordinary 689216-parameter question-only baseline, including initial and protected readouts.
No new Conda environment, package upgrades, model download or backbone checkpoint copies.

Paired siblings must differ only at the three registered fact-value token positions. A deterministic prefix-independent output can answer at most one of four; report family-level all-four success as well as per-answer accuracy.

interpretation.success: All-four sibling success with identical question tokens/positions supplies constructive evidence of prefix-conditioned information use through the retained hybrid carriers, beyond memorizing question identity. This is an immediate positive control, not long-memory or semantic-update generalization.
interpretation.failure: Still does not prove absent information; single-fact difficulty, query/control capacity, optimization and task distribution remain alternatives.
interpretation.locality: Changing a GDN query does not directly change that layer's contemporaneous K/V/gates, but changed outputs can alter downstream question-time states. This is not a pure read-only matrix probe.

primary_metric: All four different-value siblings answered correctly by unrestricted greedy decoding; also report individual-answer accuracy.
matched_baseline: Fresh zero-output ordinary local GroupController, rank 22, 689216 parameters, trained on the exact same paired positive-control inputs/order/budgets; do not warm-start the legacy adapters.
evaluation_scope: Training and validation positive-control data only; all four different-value siblings must be evaluated. No new original-test or 70000-series inference.
